title: Shifted-cycle subcomplex of a filtered complex
statement: For a decreasing filtration L of a cochain complex K, use the canonical decalage filtration [lem-sp-filtered-complex-decalage]. Define decalageComplex(a) as its step a viewed as a complex, decalageι(a) as its canonical monic inclusion into K, and decalageStep(a,n) as its degreewise image subobject. These are abbreviations of the canonical filtration API, not a second construction.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories and Homology

proof.text: Take the step and its inclusion from the proved canonical decalage filtration. The degreewise subobject is the complexStep of that filtration, so its image identity is definitional. The canonical decalage formula gives the intersection of the shifted original step with the inverse image of the next shifted step.
